problem_statement: Build a brand-new /topics page from scratch on this Gatsby Advanced Starter site. The /topics route does not exist yet (empty/404 in baseline). Mount the page in the site's existing shared shell (the gatsby-theme-amaranth Layout: same header/navigation, footer, and theme tokens as the home and about pages) so it is visually consistent with the rest of the site. On the page, show a heading, an intro line, a row of topic checkboxes (a multi-select filter), a live status line, and a responsive grid of resource cards. Ticking one or more topic checkboxes must filter the card grid to only resources tagged with any selected topic and update the status line; clearing all checkboxes shows everything. The page must not overflow horizontally on mobile.
required_content: Mount the page inside the shared site Layout so the header/navigation and footer match the other pages (cross-page consistency)
A page title heading (h1) reading Topics

An intro paragraph (p) explaining that resources can be filtered by topic; include the phrase 'by topic' (reference copy: 'Filter our resources by topic. Tick one or more topics to narrow the list, or leave them all clear to see everything.')

A filter bar with one checkbox per topic, in this order: React, GraphQL, Performance, Accessibility. Each checkbox input MUST carry a data-topic attribute whose value is the lowercased topic (data-topic="react", data-topic="graphql", data-topic="performance", data-topic="accessibility") so the filter can be targeted.

A live status line paragraph (p) that reads exactly 'Showing N of M resources' where M is the total number of resource cards and N is the number currently shown after filtering (initially all: 'Showing 8 of 8 resources').

A responsive grid of exactly these 8 resource cards (each an <article> with an h3 title, a short blurb paragraph, and its topic tag(s)). Use this exact dataset so the filtered counts are well-defined: (1) 'Hooks Deep Dive' — Patterns for composing state and effects in function components. — tags: React; (2) 'Suspense for Data' — Streaming data reads without blocking the whole render tree. — tags: React, Performance; (3) 'GraphQL Schemas' — Designing types and resolvers that stay easy to evolve. — tags: GraphQL; (4) 'Query Batching' — Coalescing requests to cut round-trips on data-heavy pages. — tags: GraphQL, Performance; (5) 'Bundle Splitting' — Shipping less JavaScript up front with route-level code splits. — tags: Performance; (6) 'Focus Management' — Keeping keyboard focus predictable across route changes. — tags: Accessibility; (7) 'ARIA Patterns' — Applying roles and states so widgets read correctly to AT. — tags: Accessibility; (8) 'Semantic HTML' — Reaching for the right element before adding extra markup. — tags: Accessibility, React.

Multi-select behavior: checking one or more topics filters the grid to resources matching ANY checked topic and updates the status line count; unchecking returns them. With ONLY the React topic checked, exactly 3 of the 8 resources match (Hooks Deep Dive, Suspense for Data, Semantic HTML), so the status line must read 'Showing 3 of 8 resources'.
No horizontal overflow at mobile width
design_constraints: Reuse the gatsby-theme-amaranth design system: import Layout, LayoutWidthContainer and the H1/H3/Body/Caption typography primitives from gatsby-theme-amaranth
Use the theme CSS custom properties for color (var(--color-primary), var(--color-grey-*), var(--color-text))

Palette (match the rest of the site): page background white (#ffffff), resource cards use the site's light-grey card surface (#f7f7f7) with rounded corners, near-black body text; muted grey (~#b8b5b5) for secondary/tag captions.

Layout: heading + intro at top, the topic checkbox filter bar and status line above the grid; the resource grid is multi-column on desktop and collapses to fewer columns (single column) on small screens. Cards reuse the site's grey card surface and rounded styling.
author_notes: Plan A: baseline src/pages/topics.tsx is an empty fragment (route present but blank, no Layout → text_length 0). reference implements the full page with a useState checkbox multi-select filter over 8 inlined resources. bad is byte-similar at default paint (all 8 cards + chrome render → passes 18 gates) but the checkbox onChange is a no-op and visible is hardcoded to all resources → checking a topic never filters → fails ONLY interaction_assertions. Cross-page consistency (#18ag) encoded as dom_assertions binding shared nav (Posts/About) + footer (LINKS / Based on) on BOTH desktop_topics AND the sibling desktop_about. Interaction: check input[data-topic=react] → status becomes 'Showing 3 of 8'. Test files (*.spec.tsx/*.cy.ts) stripped from all 3 workspaces; gatsby-plugin-offline removed (SW console error #18ai/#18al); @parcel/namer-default@2.6.0 added to fix Gatsby4 parcel-config compile. md5 distinct driven by topics.tsx.
